claim: Amazon Managed Grafana is integrated with AWS data sources that collect operational data, such as Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon OpenSearch Service, AWS X-Ray, AWS IoT SiteWise, Amazon Timestream and Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, and it also supports many open-source, third-party and other cloud data sources.
q: Which data sources can Amazon Managed Grafana query?
v: Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon OpenSearch Service, AWS X-Ray
ev: docs/grafana/latest/userguide/what-is-Amazon-Managed-Service-Grafana

Amazon Managed Grafana is integrated with AWS data sources that collect operational data, such as Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon OpenSearch Service, AWS X-Ray, AWS IoT SiteWise, Amazon Timestream, and Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus. Amazon Managed Grafana includes a permission provisioning feature for adding supported AWS services as data sources. Amazon Managed Grafana also supports many popular open-source, third-party, and other cloud data sources.

claim: By default, traffic from an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace to data sources or notification channels flows via the public Internet; if you connect the workspace to a VPC, all traffic flows via your VPC.

ev: docs/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc
By default, traffic from your Amazon Managed Grafana workspace to data sources or notification channels flows via the public Internet.
docs/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc

claim: When you have not configured a private VPC and Amazon Managed Grafana connects to publicly accessible data sources, it connects to some AWS services in the same Region, such as CloudWatch, Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and AWS X-Ray, through AWS PrivateLink, so that traffic does not flow via the public Internet.
q: Does Managed Grafana traffic to CloudWatch, Prometheus and X-Ray use the public internet?
v: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and AWS X-Ray
ev: docs/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc

When you have not configured a private VPC, and Amazon Managed Grafana is connecting to publicly accessible data sources, it connects to some AWS services in the same region via AWS PrivateLink. This includes services such as CloudWatch, Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and AWS X-Ray. Traffic to those services does not flow via the public Internet.

docs/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-nac
